purpose: One bounded corrected replacement diagnostic of the current working-tree native lifecycle. The prior one-run attempt passed its test but omitted substage events because cfg(test) is not set for zg-engine when compiled as a zg-daemon dependency; this protocol explicitly enables the non-default profiling feature.
not_a_claim: This is not a paired performance comparison, statistical qualification, or production qualification.
Per-job process CPU/write deltas include concurrent query-sampler and daemon-process work; they are correlational, not exclusive native-call costs.
The opt-in finalization event is emitted after the store state lock is released, but stderr output can still perturb the workload slightly; query p95 remains diagnostic only.
The P1 v7 result, the first current-tree profile, and the incomplete v1 substage attempt are separate evidence and will not be pooled with this run.
This replacement is a single diagnostic only; it does not authorize automatic retry, candidate changes, or production promotion.

workload.fixture_mutations: append a unique synthetic FTS marker to selected frozen Rust files; rename one marked file, then delete it

query.p95: nearest-rank p95 of successful end-to-end search_workspace_index wall time
query.schedule: serial; no overlap or backfill; missed starts counted

workload.embedding: deterministic fixed test embedding; no inference or network

profile_instrumentation.environment_toggle: ZVEC_GREP_NATIVE_PROFILE=1; event emitted only when this is set and the cargo feature is enabled
scheduler_fields: changed path count and rescan status
process write_bytes and CPU tick deltas across each executor call
process RSS/PSS snapshots at executor completion
profile_instrumentation.finalization_event: NATIVE_PROFILE event=store_finalize; emitted after the store state lock is released when the explicit feature and environment toggle are both active
finalization_fields: directories/entities/files/fragments optimize duration and write-byte delta
mutation counters, maintenance debt/policy, optimize decision/reason
fragment completeness before/after, acknowledgement/epoch status, error code
profile_instrumentation.concurrency_note: Per-job process counters include concurrent queries and other work in the test process; use them to rank candidate stages, not as exclusive attribution.
profile_instrumentation.post_job_delay: none; capture idle/background tail through the external runner's cgroup telemetry

sample_design.order: single corrected replacement diagnostic current-tree run; no control/candidate arm
sample_design.retry: no automatic retry; classify blocked, failed, or incomplete runs without repeating

resource_envelope.execution: systemd-run --user --scope with effective cgroup verification and live monitor

interpretation: Use per-finalization-stage timings only to decide whether a correctness-preserving candidate merits separate owner review. This run does not authorize an A/B, behavior change, default change, or production promotion. If a candidate appears supported, first report evidence and limits, then obtain/confirm authorization and freeze a separate paired control/candidate protocol; preserve synchronous fragment-delete visibility.
